brand_summary: Sarvam AI has rapidly established itself as India's premier sovereign AI platform by launching its Saaras V4 speech-to-text model across 22 languages and securing high-profile enterprise partnerships with Maruti Suzuki, IndiGo, and IDFC FIRST Bank. Moving forward, the brand is targeting global AI policy leadership, scaling enterprise adoption via its Circle Programme, and laying the groundwork for a massive trillion-parameter model backed by India-hosted inference infrastructure.
